incident_text: A brick building partly collapsed after the earthquake. Bricks are lying across the street.

result.scene_summary: A multi-story brick building with significant structural damage and debris on the street corner, with traffic lights and a street sign visible. In the background, modern buildings stand under a partly cloudy sky.

observations.description: A brick building with collapsed upper floors, exposed wooden beams, and broken windows.
A traffic light pole with a signal, a street sign with "No S" visible, and a green awning that is torn.
A pile of bricks and debris on the sidewalk, an orange traffic cone, and a green tarp.
Trees visible in the distance behind the buildings.

not_determinable: extent of damage to other buildings
